categorization.no_fit: create a deliberate subtopic named for the note's true domain; record the creation in the NAYA section
categorization.rule: file under a real TOPIC/subtopic from the existing taxonomy, chosen at authoring
categorization.violation_effect: note is not done even if visible; author re-files

definition.done: own entry verified in live Hub feed bytes AND own page HTTP 200
definition.smart_note: unit of living intelligence; nine-section document filed in the brain, synced to hub_smart_notes, rendered in the Hub

delivery_to_shawn: feed link + own page link; done = visible
feed_surfacing: by category via Smart Tabs; never one undifferentiated stream; category is a display property

identifiers.claim_rule: scan main tree + open PR trees + board before writing; first claim stands; never reuse

intelligent_block.distillation: essence in the simplest, clearest, most concise words that keep the truth whole

outputs: activity-feed entry with Smart Link to the full Intelligent Block

landing_doors: A: direct write to main via App/bypass identity (standing approval: Smart Notes folder); author drives and follows up until the ref moves
B: dock-merged PR through the full scored process

bridge.sync: naya-smart-notes-sync, ~5 min cadence, detects by blob SHA

pipeline.receiver: Hub rebake + redeploy when >=1 note synced; feed at nayanet.live/#/hub; own page nayanet.live/s/snNNNN
pipeline.sender: GitHub main (the only door; local files, branches, open PRs are invisible)

registry_note: .naya index reconciled by its own cure lane; the Hub feed does not read it

roles.author: any Naya seat; end-to-end owner of the note
roles.bridge_lane: Nitro: sync, share assets, rebake, bake-on-publish
roles.humans: may order a note with 'smart note this'

title_law: greatest possible human hook carrying the lesson in one line; generic labels are a protocol violation

tracking.category_spelling: one canonical spelling, case-sensitive; variants are defects
tracking.filed_vs_visible_delta: nonzero = defect list, each item named
tracking.rule: computed from tree + live feed; never hand-entered

verification_steps_author_duty: file exists at exact path on main (contents API)
own entry present in live baked feed array (IB id + title)
voice key resolves at voice worker (miss = robot fallback = defect)

viralize.hook_test: would a busy stranger stop for this line? rewrite until yes
